brief:
The Palestinian Centre for Human Rights condemned settler militia gunfire that killed two Palestinians in separate incidents in the occupied West Bank. In the first attack, one Palestinian died and 19 others, including two children, were wounded when settler militias opened fire on Palestinians harvesting olives.

The killings occurred days apart. The PCHR said it was issuing its strongest condemnation of the attacks by Israeli settler militias.
dek: The Palestinian Centre for Human Rights (PCHR) condemns in the strongest terms the killing of two Palestinians by Israeli settler militias in two separate attacks in the occupied West Bank, days apart. In the first attack, a Palestinian was killed and 19 others, including two children, were injured when settler militias attacked Palestinians harvesting olives…
title: Settler militia kills two Palestinians in separate West Bank attacks
